tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
As per terms and conditions of tender documents

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have a minimum experience of Five years in the field of in Designing, Manufacturing, Testing & Supply of 66kV & above Current Transformers as on the date of bid submission. (Tenderers shall have to upload the supporting Documents such as Purchase order copies /order completion certificates/ performance certificates.

The Tenderer shall be individual Proprietorship firm or partnership firm or Company Registered under Companies Act 1956/2013.Tenderer shall upload Registration certificate/IRSI certificate/Udyam certificate MIME/Partnership deed/license issued by the Commerce and Industries department or any other Government statutory Authority shall be uploaded. For Proprietorship, firm, PAN and GST registration certificate shall be uploaded.

The bidder should have Manufactured & Supplied at least 50% (25% in respect of Micro & Small scale Enterprises) of tendered quantity of 66kV & above Current Transformers specified in the present enquiry to State/Central owned Transmission Utilities/ Generation Utilities/ PSUs (Tenderers shall have to upload the supporting documents such as Purchase order copies/order completion certificates/ performance certificates).

The Bidder shall furnish the Performance Certificates for atleast 50% (25% in respect of Micro & Small scale Enterprises) of the tendered quantity of Current Transformers of various ratios of Tendered material or higher capacity of this bid and should have been issued by the State/Central Owned Electricity utilities / Generating Utilities only, and issuing officer shall not be below the rank of Executive Engineer or equivalent division head. The Performance Certificate shall indicate the rating of the Current Transformers Make, Type, Rating, Name of the Sub-Station where it is installed, date of commissioning etc., in order to show that tendered materials of this bid was in successful operation for at least a Minimum period of Two years as on the date of bid opening.

The Bidder shall furnish Type Test Certificate not older than Seven years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type test at a CPRI or ERDA as per latest IS (The seismic and cantilever Test conducted at IITs or IISc will be accepted.Type Test reports required for all the Type, Capacity and Ratios indicated the tender, issued from CPRI or ERDA lab shall be uploaded).In case the type test reports for the specified equipment/material in the present enquiry are older than 7 (Seven) years or if type test reports are issued by NABL laboratory (Other than CPRI/ERDA) or if one/some of the test reports are not available for the specified equipment/material in the present enquiry, in that case the bidder shall give an undertaking agreeing to conduct all type tests on the 1st Unit or any other unit at the discretion of KPTCL in a CPRI/ERDA Laboratory if order is placed on the firm without affecting the Delivery Schedule and at no extra cost to KPTCL. KPTCL may conduct type tests as per relevant standards at its cost on a random sample of Tendered material /equipment specified in the present enquiry at any point of time during the contract at CPRI/ERDA Laboratory. However the successful bidder shall have to bear the transportation cost. The bidder shall have to give an undertaking to this effect. Otherwise the bid is liable to be rejected. This clause is not applicable if the bidder submits/uploads the type test certificates not older than 07 years as on the date of bid opening for having conducted successful type tests at CPRI/ERDA test house as per relevant IS/IEC standards.

Financial Capability corresponding to bidders highest Annual Turnover of the best one year during preceding 3 years shall not be less than 187.20 lakhs (2 times of the amount put to Tender). The bidder shall upload audited annual financial statements such as Profit & Loss statement, Balance sheet for preceding 3 years duly certified by a Chartered Accountant.

i)In case the information furnished by the Bidder/Bidders is found to be false at any stage of tendering /execution, then KPTCL, at its discretion may take action against such Bidder/Bidders. If false information is found at the Tendering stage, KPTCL may forfeit the EMD paid, disqualify the offer of such Bidder and /or Black list the Firm. If false information is found at execution stage then KPTCL may cancel the order, forfeit the Bank Guarantee furnished against the performance of the contract, Black list the Firm and recover excess money paid by KPTCL (if any).

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have been blacklisted by any State/Central Generating/ Transmission Utility/PSUs as on the date of bid submission. The bidder shall upload a declaration in this regard and non-furnishing of the declaration will result in rejection of the Bid.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should not have been blacklisted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should provide detailed information on any litigation or arbitration arising out of contracts completed or under execution by it over the last five years with KPTCL. A history of awards involving litigations against the bidder or any part or JV may result in rejection of bid. Bidders should furnish the self declaration stating the above and upload the same along with the other documents in the relevant field in the e-procurement portal, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected.
If part or full price sheets or prices are exposed in the Techno-Commercial Sheets or Techno-Commercial Bid of the Bidder then, the offer of the Bidder will be rejected.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Techno-Commercial Sheets or Techno-Commercial Bid condition

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The performance of the equipments supplied by the bidder in the past would also be reckoned for considering the offers.

The offer of the bidders taking deviations in following clauses will be summarily rejected.a Validity of offer.b.Earnest Money Deposit.c.Contract performance security.d.Payment terms.e.Guarantee.f.Penalty.g.Stipulated Delivery Schedule.h.Price Basis.i.Type testj.Change in offered quantity gainst tendered quantity.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall upload the power of attorney in the prescribed format on Rs.5000/- Stamp paper.
The Bid Enquiry No. shall be clearly and legibly indicated in the Bank Guarantee.
The Bid Enquiry number shall be superscribed on the Sealed cover.
Documentary evidence wherever required shall be uploaded. No hard copies will be accepted except Power of Attorney as stated above. No deviation & Letter of Undertaking.

Not with standing anything stated above, KPTCL reserves the right to assess the bidders capability to perform the work, should the circumstances warrant such assessment in the overall interest of KPTCL.
The bidder should have Goods and Services Tax GST Registration and shall upload the necessary supporting document to establish compliance for having GST registration.
Tenders from consortium/JV are not acceptable.
